interval_years.quote: Any license to practice optometry issued by the board shall expire on May 31 of the year specified by the board for the expiration of the license and shall be renewed on a biennial basis

renewal_fee_usd.quote: The biennial renewal fee shall not exceed $800.

required.quote: each licensee applying for license renewal shall furnish to the secretary of the board satisfactory evidence of successfully completing a minimum of 24 hours of continuing education annually

hours_per_period.quote: successfully completing a minimum of 24 hours of continuing education annually

period_years.quote: a minimum of 24 hours of continuing education annually

value: ocular pharmacology, therapeutics or related topics of study (5 hours)
topical_requirements.quote: five hours of which shall relate to ocular pharmacology, therapeutics or related topics of study, approved by the board

available.quote: Any applicant for reciprocal licensure may in the board's discretion be licensed and issued a license without examination if the applicant has been in the active practice of optometry in another state for at least the three-year period immediately preceding the application for reciprocal licensure

requirements.value: Applicant must have been in active practice in another state for at least three years; present a certified copy of license from a state with equivalent requirements that grants reciprocity to Kansas licensees; submit sworn statement that license has never been limited, suspended or revoked; pass Kansas law examination and any required clinical practice examination; pay reciprocal license fee not to exceed $450.
requirements.quote: Presents a certified copy of a certificate of registration or license which has been issued to the applicant by another state where the requirements for licensure are deemed by the board to be equivalent to the requirements for licensure under this act, if such state accords a like privilege to holders of a license issued by the board

credential_type.quote: if such person complies with the other qualifications for licensing and passes such examination, such person shall receive from the board, upon the payment of a fee fixed by the board by rules and regulations in an amount of not to exceed $150, a license entitling such person to practice optometry

disciplinary_grounds.description: Committed fraud or misrepresentation in applying for or securing an original or renewal license.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: The licensee has committed fraud or misrepresentation in applying for or securing an original or renewal license.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Committed an act of unprofessional conduct or professional incompetence.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: The licensee has committed an act of unprofessional conduct or professional incompetence.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Convicted of a felony, whether or not related to the practice of optometry.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: The licensee has been convicted of a felony, whether or not related to the practice of optometry.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Used fraudulent or false advertisements.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: The licensee has used fraudulent or false advertisements.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Willfully or repeatedly violated the optometry law, the pharmacy act, or the uniform controlled substances act.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: The licensee has willfully or repeatedly violated the optometry law, the pharmacy act of the state of Kansas or the uniform controlled substances act, or any rules and regulations adopted pursuant thereto.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Violated an order of the board.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: The licensee has violated an order of the board.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Failed to pay renewal fees specified in the act.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: The licensee has failed to pay renewal fees specified in this act.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Failed to comply with the annual continuing education requirements.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: The licensee has failed to comply with the annual continuing education requirements as required by this act and the board.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Engaged in the practice of optometry under a false or assumed name, or impersonation of another practitioner.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: The licensee has engaged in the practice of optometry under a false or assumed name, or the impersonation of another practitioner.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Inability to perform optometry practice acts with reasonable skill and safety due to illness, substance abuse, or mental/physical condition.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: The licensee has the inability to perform optometry practice acts with reasonable skill and safety to patients by reason of illness, alcoholism, excessive use of drugs, controlled substances, chemical or any other type of material or as a result of any mental or physical condition.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Had a license revoked, suspended, or limited, or faced other disciplinary action, in another jurisdiction.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: The licensee has had a license to practice optometry revoked, suspended or limited, has been censured or has had other disciplinary action taken, or an application for a license denied, by the proper licensing authority of another state, territory, District of Columbia, or other country

disciplinary_grounds.description: Violated any lawful rules and regulations or orders of the board.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: The licensee has violated any lawful rules and regulations promulgated by the board or violated any lawful order or directive of the board previously entered by the board.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Cheated on or attempted to subvert the validity of the licensing examination.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: The licensee has cheated on or attempted to subvert the validity of the examination for a license.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Found to be mentally ill, disabled, not guilty by reason of insanity, or incompetent to stand trial by a court.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: The licensee has been found to be mentally ill, disabled, not guilty by reason of insanity, not guilty because the licensee suffers from a mental disease or defect or incompetent to stand trial by a court of competent jurisdiction.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Violated a federal law or regulation relating to controlled substances.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: The licensee has violated a federal law or regulation relating to controlled substances.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Failed to furnish the board or its investigators any legally requested information.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: The licensee has failed to furnish the board, or its investigators or representatives, any information legally requested by the board.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Sanctions or disciplinary actions taken against the licensee by a peer review committee, health care facility, or professional association.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Sanctions or disciplinary actions have been taken against the licensee by a peer review committee, health care facility or a professional association or society for acts or conduct similar to acts or conduct which would constitute grounds for disciplinary action under this section.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Failed to report to the board any adverse action taken by another state, licensing jurisdiction, or other body.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: The licensee has failed to report to the board any adverse action taken against the licensee by another state or licensing jurisdiction, a peer review body, a health care facility, a professional association or society, a governmental agency, by a law enforcement agency or a court

disciplinary_grounds.description: Surrendered a license or professional membership in another jurisdiction while under investigation for similar conduct.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: The licensee has surrendered a license or authorization to practice optometry in another state or jurisdiction or has surrendered the licensee's membership on any professional staff or in any professional association or society while under investigation

disciplinary_grounds.description: Failed to report to the board the surrender of a license or membership while under investigation.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: The licensee has failed to report to the board surrender of the licensee's license or authorization to practice optometry in another state or jurisdiction or surrender of the licensee's membership on any professional staff or in any professional association or society while under investigation

disciplinary_grounds.description: Had an adverse judgment, award, or settlement from a medical liability claim related to conduct that would constitute grounds for discipline.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: The licensee has an adverse judgment, award or settlement against the licensee resulting from a medical liability claim related to acts or conduct similar to acts or conduct which would constitute grounds for disciplinary action under this section.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Failed to report to the board any adverse malpractice judgment, settlement, or award.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: The licensee has failed to report to the board any adverse judgment, settlement or award against the licensee resulting from a malpractice liability claim

disciplinary_grounds.description: Failed to maintain a policy of professional liability insurance as required by law.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: The licensee has failed to maintain a policy of professional liability insurance as required by K.S.A. 40-3402 or 40-3403a

disciplinary_grounds.description: Knowingly submitted any misleading, deceptive, false, or fraudulent representation on a claim form, bill, or statement.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: The licensee has knowingly submitted any misleading, deceptive, false or fraudulent representation on a claim form bill or statement.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Failed to provide the patient with a written prescription for lenses for eyeglasses after eye examination.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: The licensee has failed to provide to a patient the patient's written prescription for lenses for eyeglasses subsequent to the completion of the eye examination in accordance with applicable state or federal law.

insurance_required.quote: All applicants for licensure, in addition to successfully completing all other requirements for licensure, shall submit evidence satisfactory to the board of professional liability insurance in an amount acceptable to the board.

definition_quote.value: The practice of optometry means: (1) The examination of the human eye and its adnexae and the employment of objective or subjective means or methods (including the administering, prescribing or dispensing, of topical pharmaceutical drugs) for the purpose of diagnosing the refractive, muscular, or pathological condition thereof; (2) the prescribing, dispensing or adapting of lenses..., prisms, low vision rehabilitation services, orthoptic exercises and visual training therapy...; and (3) the prescribing, administering or dispensing of topical pharmaceutical drugs and oral drugs for the examination, diagnosis and treatment of ocular conditions and any insufficiencies or abnormal conditions of the human eye and its adnexae including adult open-angle glaucoma.
definition_quote.quote: The practice of optometry means: (1) The examination of the human eye and its adnexae and the employment of objective or subjective means or methods (including the administering, prescribing or dispensing, of topical pharmaceutical drugs) for the purpose of diagnosing the refractive, muscular, or pathological condition thereof

methods_authorized.quote: The examination of the human eye and its adnexae and the employment of objective or subjective means or methods (including the administering, prescribing or dispensing, of topical pharmaceutical drugs) for the purpose of diagnosing the refractive, muscular, or pathological condition thereof

drug_authority.value: Licensees may prescribe, administer, and dispense topical pharmaceutical drugs and oral drugs (including oral antibacterial, antiviral, antihistamines, analgesics, steroids, antiglaucoma drugs, and other oral drugs with clinically accepted ocular uses) for examination, diagnosis, and treatment of ocular conditions including adult open-angle glaucoma. Dispensing of prescription-only medication is limited to a 24-hour supply or minimal quantity until a prescription can be filled by a licensed pharmacist.
drug_authority.quote: the prescribing, administering or dispensing of topical pharmaceutical drugs and oral drugs for the examination, diagnosis and treatment of ocular conditions and any insufficiencies or abnormal conditions of the human eye and its adnexae including adult open-angle glaucoma

surgery_prohibited.quote: The practice of optometry shall not include: ... the performance of surgery, including the use of lasers for surgical purposes, except that licensees may remove non-perforating foreign bodies from the cornea, conjunctiva or eyelids

surgery_definition.value: Surgery is not defined in the statute beyond the prohibition language, but the practice of optometry shall not include the performance of surgery, including the use of lasers for surgical purposes, and shall not include procedures requiring anesthesia administered by injection or general anesthesia.
surgery_definition.quote: the performance of surgery, including the use of lasers for surgical purposes, except that licensees may remove non-perforating foreign bodies from the cornea, conjunctiva or eyelids; remove eyelashes; scrape the cornea for diagnostic tests, smears or cultures; dilate, probe, irrigate or close by punctal plug the tear drainage structures of the eye; express conjunctival follicles or cysts; debridement of the corneal epithelium and co-management of post-operative care
